info.name: Ejada E-commerce (Gateway)
info.description:
End-to-end API for the Ejada e-commerce microservices, all through the API gateway.

AUTH MODEL:
- Public: register, login, refresh, GET products (shop & inventory), /actuator/health.
- Authenticated (Bearer access token): wallet, cart, orders — ownership enforced (self or admin).
- Admin only: create admin users, and create/update/delete products.

FEATURES: product pagination (?page&size&sort); admin-managed payment methods (shopper picks one at checkout via paymentMethodCode); admin discount codes (shopper applies via discountCode).

RUN THE SUITES: folder '11. E2E Smoke Flow' = full happy path with assertions; folder '12. Logic Tests (errors)' = every error path with assertions. Run each folder top-to-bottom (folder Run / Collection Runner). On the free tier, wake services first (8. Health & Security > Gateway health).

All services are reachable ONLY through the gateway; direct calls are blocked by a shared internal key.

item.name: 11. E2E Smoke Flow

request.description: Run this whole folder top-to-bottom (folder ▶ Run). Covers payment-method choice + discount codes.

item.name: 2) Admin adds a CARD payment method

exec: var d=pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('productId', d.id); pm.collectionVariables.set('sku', d.sku);
var d=pm.response.json(); pm.collectionVariables.set('token', d.accessToken); pm.collectionVariables.set('userId', d.user.id);

pm.test('PAID, total 80, 20% off, WALLET', function(){ pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('PAID'); pm.expect(Number(d.totalAmount)).to.eql(80); pm.expect(d.discountPercent).to.eql(20); pm.expect(d.paymentMethod).to.eql('WALLET'); });

item.name: 11) Add product x1 to a new cart
12) Checkout with CARD (external, no wallet debit)

exec: pm.test('PAID via CARD, total 50', function(){ pm.response.to.have.status(201); pm.expect(d.status).to.eql('PAID'); pm.expect(Number(d.totalAmount)).to.eql(50); pm.expect(d.paymentMethod).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('e2eCard')); });

item.description: Full happy-path E2E: admin adds a payment method + a discount code + a product; shopper buys once with WALLET+discount (asserts 20% off and wallet debit) and once with CARD (asserts no wallet debit). Wake services first on the free tier.
